ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  3B BlackBio Dx Limited has re-appointed Mrs. Mithla Dubey, 79, as a director to ensure compliance with the mandatory woman director requirement. However, this re-appointment raises governance concerns as she is a promoter director and mother of both the Chairman cum Managing Director and the Whole-Time Director cum CFO, suggesting limited independent oversight and substantial familial control over the board.
